high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues of pink and orange in the sky. The sky is filled with soft, scattered clouds that are tinged with these warm colors, creating a tranquil and somewhat dreamy atmosphere. The ocean dominates the lower portion of the image, with gentle waves rolling towards the shore. The water has a muted brownish tone, likely due to the lighting conditions, which adds to the overall calmness of the scene.
